problem:
The basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the matrix $[\,T\,]_{B}$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ relative to $B$ are given by

$$
B={[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}]},\,[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-7 & b & -25 \\ a & 1 & -\frac{1}{3} \\ 2 & 0 & c\end{aligned}].
$$

What is the value of $\,a+b+c,\,$ given that  

$$
T([\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}y-z \\ x+y-z \\ x+y\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Let's denote the vectors of $B$ as ${{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}.$ The $B$-matrix for $T$ is a matrix whose columns are the coordinates of the vectors $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $B.$

First, let's find the image of ${b}_{1},$ ${b}_{2},$ and ${b}_{3}$ under $T,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}T({b}_{1}) & =T([\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ T({b}_{2}) & =T([\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\ T({b}_{3}) & =T([\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}])=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

To find the coordinates of $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2}),$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $B$, we consider the matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}| & | & | & | & | & | \\ {b}_{1} & {b}_{2} & {b}_{3} & T({b}_{1}) & T({b}_{2}) & T({b}_{3}) \\ | & | & | & | & | & |\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we reduce the left-hand side to reduced row echelon form using Gaussian elimination. Then, on the right-hand side, we will obtain the $B$-matrix for $T:$

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 & -1 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 0 & 3 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 & 4 & 1 & 3 & 3\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{2}:=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 & -1 & 3 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2 & 0 & 7\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}-3{R}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -7 & 3 & -25 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & -\frac{1}{3} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 2 & 0 & 7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 & -25 \\ 0 & 1 & -\frac{1}{3} \\ 2 & 0 & 7\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, $a=0,$ $b=3,$ $c=7$ and 

$$
a+b+c=0+3+7=10.
$$
